in_hebrew.name: Horwath
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Horwath הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Horos, meaning 'ruler' or 'time'. In the Bible, Horus is an Egyptian god associated with the sun. The name Horwath suggests a strong, ruling presence.
